description: SASRec predicts the next item by applying causal self-attention to interaction histories. Learned item and positional embeddings pass through attention and feed-forward blocks with residual connections, normalization and dropout. Final sequence features score candidates through shared item embeddings. [Paper](https://arxiv.org/html/1808.09781)
motivation: Attention selects relevant past interactions, combining recent-action signals with longer dependencies. This addresses varying interaction density; it does not directly solve unseen-item or zero-history cold start.
implementation_notes: The paper uses shifted next-item supervision, sampled binary cross-entropy and Adam. For this task, retain sasrec_perdataset routing across Movies_and_TV, Industrial_and_Scientific, Electronics and CDs_and_Vinyl; preprocessing seed 0, training seed 42, and the 200-epoch environment default. Keep DATA_DIR = os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR'] and artifacts under the trial directory. Select using the pinned macro validation HR@10 only. Preserve DiagnosisProbe(view, device), run_full_diagnosis(train_loader), measured metrics with definitions, and diagnosis_interpreter_prompt(raw_diagnosis). Update the predictor writer whenever architecture changes. No experiments or benchmark gains are reported here.
pseudocode:
for each category:
    load unchanged training split
    build padded histories and shifted positive targets
    sample unseen negative items
    features = causal_SASRec(item_embeddings + position_embeddings)
    loss = masked_BCE(features · positive_embeddings, 1)
         + masked_BCE(features · negative_embeddings, 0)
    optimize; save model and matching predictor configuration
select trials using the common four-category macro validation HR@10

originality.positive: The original paper introduced an influential attention-based sequential recommender.
originality.negative: The supplied idea repeats the existing SASRec baseline without a concrete new mechanism.

future_potential.positive: Permitted titles and descriptions could support a future content-aware extension for rare items.
future_potential.negative: That extension is a hypothesis; its value requires validation within the shared budget.

code_difficulty.positive: Starting from the supplied SASRec baseline limits implementation work.
code_difficulty.negative: Causal masking, padding, dataset routing and training–prediction consistency require care.
